_comment: Hosting config for civildigital.co.uk. Deliberately hosting-only: the Cloud
Functions for the App Testing booking flow keep their own config at
firebase/firebase.json and their own deploy path, so this pilot cannot
disturb a live payment flow. Deploy the site with:
run from this directory. Functions still deploy from firebase/ as before.
cleanUrls is OFF on purpose. Turning it on would 301 every .html URL on the
site - about.html, contact.html, faq.html and the four service pages are all
in the sitemap and indexed by Google.
appAssociation is NONE on purpose. Left on AUTO, Firebase generates its own
/.well-known/assetlinks.json and would silently override the committed one
that Android App Links verification depends on.
